meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, history, clean, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会用 HyperFrames CLI 走完整流程:初始化项目、在本地目录搜动效并安装、编写合成、跑 lint 和 check、开预览、渲染并用 ffprobe 验证输出;也能排查构建或渲染失败。
howto.when: 当你要走 HyperFrames CLI 的开发流程(初始化、检查、渲染等),或需要诊断构建、渲染失败时触发。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the HyperFrames CLI loop: init a project, search the local catalog for a move and install it, author the composition, run lint and check, preview, render, then verify the output. It also helps diagnose build or render failures.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want the HyperFrames CLI development loop (init, check, render, and more), or when diagnosing build or render failures.
